status_authority.release_candidate_revision_rule: Both Development functions and every eligible synthetic deployment row must report the exact selected release-candidate SHA.
status_authority.package_parity_rule: The two deployed packages must match sanitized checksums computed from that release candidate.

deferred_evidence.boundary: Not required to begin one-number controlled internal phone testing. A second number and live two-number isolation proof are required before claiming the separate first-controlled-prospect technical gate.

Paid/native voice cases, interruption and noise refinement, and number-webhook timeout/503/malformed/invalid-override/unavailable behavior remain controlled Retell work. They do not invalidate the completed Catalyst lifecycle.
A real contractor test still requires prospect-facing legal/privacy review, approved recipient and route, and explicit routing approval.

known_mvp_tradeoffs: There is no pre-call reservation. Concurrent calls already in flight when the 25th handled call converges may create a visible practical overshoot.
Every first valid terminal ended post-call event counts once; error and not-connected lifecycle rows remain uncounted and notification waits for call_analyzed.
Catalyst query plus JSON or CSV is the reporting path; Analytics and CRM writes are absent.
Number reassignment is not a runtime feature. The current non-customer number remains frozen to its Development deployment and must enter cooldown before any separately reviewed reuse.

Catalyst's edge buffers public request bodies before Advanced I/O execution; application timeout and aborted-stream codes are locally tested while public stalled or truncated requests are judged by fail-closed and zero-side-effect behavior.
